english.note: Use this for something happening in a little while, especially later in the same day.
Use 陣間 when “later” means in a little while or later today, rather than at an unspecified future time.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5

examples.english: We'll eat together later, after class.
examples.jyutping: zan6 gaan1 lok6 tong4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6
